scope: All 54 labelled mortars of the Table 2 full-factorial design (27 MCA-ACBFS, 27 GGBFS; w/b 0.45/0.5/0.55 × alkali modulus 1/1.5/2 × SS 10/15/20 wt.%). Strength and slump-flow results are reported only in figures, so no per-mix results are transcribed.

materials.name: Mechanically activated ACBFS
materials.detail: The rotation speed was 500 rpm. Ball to powder ratio of 25 and grinding duration of 20 min were used for all grindings.

materials.name: GGBFS
materials.detail: ACBFS and water-cooled GGBFS were used as precursors for this study. Both materials originated from the same source.

materials.name: liquid sodium silicate
materials.detail: The SS had an alkali modulus (AM, mass ratio SiO2/Na2O) of 2.2, with 34.37 wt.% of SiO2, 15.6 wt.% of Na2O and a solid content of 49.97 wt.%.

materials.name: sodium hydroxide pellets
materials.detail: The AM of the SS was adjusted to reach three different values of 1, 1.5 and 2.0 by addition of sodium hydroxide pellets (98% purity).

gaps: Each mix quote joins the Table 2 row cells (alkali modulus, SS wt.%, label) with the column header (precursor, water/binder) that the label sits under; the label codes (e.g. A45110 = ACBFS, w/b 0.45, AM 1, SS 10%) confirm the reading.
Mortar made with untreated ACBFS did not solidify and has no label ('Mortar, produced using only the not-treated ACBFS as a precursor, did not solidified.').
Per-mix 7- and 28-day strength and mini-slump flow appear only in Figures 6–9; the text gives group ranges (MCA-ACBFS 20–40 MPa, GGBFS 20–30 MPa at AM 1 and SS 10%) without mix labels.
The printed mill ball diameter (200 mm in a 500 mL jar) is inconsistent and stays held, as in the deep dive.
Every value awaits the second-reviewer check recorded in the batch audit before release.
